source_records.body: This chat continues the same Beryl clock register work item opened in the first chat. The Beryl clock register constraint to retain the maker mark still applies.

Fictional execution receipt for Beryl clock register. The recorded command generated a local register preview for Beryl clock register. The recorded command did not perform sharing for Beryl clock register. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.
I will put the Beryl clock register preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 15.

In Beryl, the clock raffle list is independent of the Beryl clock register. For Beryl clock raffle list, draw raffle tickets only after registration closes. I want the Beryl clock raffle list kept in planning until its own review.

For Beryl, open the clock register work item. For Beryl clock register, retain the maker mark because similar clock faces can hide different mechanisms. At this opening meeting, Beryl clock register is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Beryl clock register sets cycle duration to 14 hours. The service card is a separate follow-up to Beryl clock register.

I accept the register headings for Beryl clock register. I close Beryl clock register. While closing Beryl clock register, I do not accept the Beryl service card. At this review, cancel the Beryl service card. There is no time for the service card in this review window.
For the next step on Beryl clock register, keep replacement springs at the bench. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.

Reopen the Beryl service card because the replacement spring stops at a different point. The Beryl service card must add the winding-stop instruction. The accepted Beryl clock register stays closed while the service card is open.
Fictional local record for Beryl clock register. The first preview contains the requested register headings. This record covers a local preview only.

For Beryl, you can share the register only after Kira accepts the service card. For Beryl, permission to share the register also requires that the bench log records a full winding cycle. Both conditions for permission to share the register in Beryl are necessary because a partial cycle misses the stop point.
Fictional status record for Beryl clock raffle list. Beryl clock raffle list remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.
I believe sharing for Beryl clock register is complete because the local preview finished.
Correction for Beryl clock register: use cycle duration of 16 hours, replacing my initial value of 14 hours. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Beryl clock register.

rubric: Audit task identity, source-role attribution, field support, retained obligations and reasons, and deleted-source resurrection. No automated stored-merge correctness claim is made.
